name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Use a 4px #005fcc outer ring with a 2px white inner ring for focus indicators. This meets WCAG 2.2 AA contrast requirements on light backgrounds while remaining visible on dark ones, balancing visibility and subtlety. The trade-off is slightly more visual noise for users who rely on focus rings, but it ensures keyboard navigators can always see where they are.

name: Reader
text: The 4px #005fcc ring still fails on high-contrast patterned backgrounds where the blue blends into busy textures. A 3px white ring risks failing WCAG 2.2 AA on dark patterned backgrounds where it disappears. Test both against a 3:1 contrast ratio on actual patterned backgrounds to settle it—no theory, just measured outcomes.
